payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, specifically through a multimodal approach.

claims.text: The proposed NER model is a hybrid multimodal network that takes both image and text as input for named entity recognition.
The model significantly outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts alongside textual information.
The task of Multimodal Named Entity Recognition (MNER) specifically involves short text with accompanying images.
